conv.shortcuts_body:
**Global hotkeys** (active on the PC running AG — they work even when the browser is minimized) start/stop voice recording. The keys can be changed below (at least one modifier key required; saving applies immediately).

**From a remote device**: install the AG Client Addon and use the hotkey configured in the Addon to start/stop recording (toggle).

ℹ️ **Note:** The recording shortcuts only work while a conversation is active
conv.shortcuts_body_mac:
**Global hotkeys** (active on the Mac running AG — they work even when the browser is minimized) start/stop voice recording. The keys can be changed below (at least one modifier key required; saving applies immediately. Ctrl=⌃, Alt=⌥ Option).

⚠️ macOS requires the Input Monitoring permission. If you use multiple Spaces in Mission Control, ⌃+number may conflict with space switching (change it under System Settings > Keyboard > Keyboard Shortcuts > Mission Control). To use F1-F12, they must be set to act as standard function keys (without pressing Fn).

**From a remote device**: install the AG Client Addon and use the hotkey configured in the Addon to start/stop recording (toggle).

ℹ️ **Note:** The recording shortcuts only work while a conversation is active
conv.shortcuts_body_server:
In server mode, the global hotkeys of the PC running AG do not work on this (client) screen.

Install the **AG Client Addon** on your client device to start/stop recording (toggle) with the hotkey configured in the Addon.

ℹ️ **Note:** The recording shortcuts only work while a conversation is active

conv.refresh_desc:
**Only the recent conversation history is deleted.** Long-term memory and talk themes are kept.

Use this when the character gets stuck repeating the same phrasing or format — resetting the history clears that state.

**What is reset:**
- The recent conversation history sent in the prompt
- The conversation history shown in the UI

**What is kept:**
- Long-term memory (summary chunks)
- Talk themes
- The system prompt
conv.tuning_desc:
Adjust response generation parameters for this character.

⚠️ **These settings only apply to Ollama (local) models.** They have no effect when responses are generated via API models (ChatGPT, Gemini, etc.).
tuning.temperature.label: Creativity (temperature)
tuning.temperature.description: Adjusts the model's randomness. Lower values give logical, consistent replies; higher values make replies more emotional and unpredictable.
tuning.top_k.label: Candidate tokens (top_k)
tuning.top_k.description: When picking the next word, only the top-K most likely candidates are considered. Smaller values give safe, formulaic replies; larger values add expressive variety.
tuning.top_p.label: Breadth of speech (top_p)
tuning.top_p.description: Candidates are added from the most likely word down until their probabilities sum to p. Lower values give coherent, calm replies; higher values let topics wander more freely.
tuning.min_p.label: Minimum probability filter (min_p)
tuning.min_p.description: When picking the next word, candidates whose probability is too low relative to the most likely one are filtered out. Higher values give conservative, coherent replies; lower values keep more expressive range. Too high and wording can become monotonous or stiff.
tuning.repeat_last_n.label: Repetition detection window (repeat_last_n)
tuning.repeat_last_n.hint: Small = recent only / large = look further back / 0 = off. Typical: 500
tuning.repeat_last_n.description: Sets how many recent tokens the repetition suppression (repeat_penalty) looks at. Larger values also catch phrases used a while ago, suppressing the reappearance of the same wording. Too large and even necessary words (names, key terms) get avoided, which can sound unnatural or weaken the conversation flow. Set 0 to disable repetition suppression.
tuning.repeat_penalty.label: Repetition suppression (repeat_penalty)
tuning.repeat_penalty.hint: 1.0 = off / higher avoids repeated wording. Typical: 1.0
tuning.repeat_penalty.description: Sets how strongly recently used words and phrases are avoided. Higher values prevent the model from saying the same things over and over, but too high can sound unnatural.
tuning.presence_penalty.label: Topic switching (presence_penalty)
tuning.presence_penalty.hint: Higher = moves to new topics more easily. Typical: 0.4
tuning.presence_penalty.description: Penalizes reusing a word that has already appeared. Higher values make the model switch to new topics and phrasings instead of staying on the same subject.
tuning.frequency_penalty.label: Word overuse suppression (frequency_penalty)
tuning.frequency_penalty.hint: Higher = less likely to repeat the same words. Typical: 0.5
tuning.frequency_penalty.description: Penalizes frequently used words more strongly. Higher values curb the habit of repeating the same words and phrases.
tuning.num_predict.label: Reply length (num_predict)
tuning.num_predict.description: Maximum number of tokens generated per turn. Smaller values give short, punchy replies; larger values allow longer explanations.

elyth.session_desc: In an ELYTH session, enabled characters access ELYTH (an SNS for AI characters) on their own and post, reply, like and more. Sessions run automatically at the configured interval.

api.title: API Settings
api.page_desc: Set API keys for each service here to make their models and voices selectable in the character settings (create / edit).
api.desc: Configure external LLM API keys and model settings.
api.embedding_desc: Select the embedding model for memory search and topic detection. Applies to all characters.
api.imagen_desc: Select the Imagen model used for image generation. Requires a Google API key.
api.ollama_ctx_desc: The conversation context window (num_ctx) for Ollama models. Larger values fit more history and memories but consume more VRAM for the KV cache (14B-class guide: 16,000≈2.5GB / 32,000≈5GB / 64,000≈10GB). If the model no longer fits in VRAM, generation does not fail — it just becomes much slower (a WARN appears in the logs). Changes apply from the next response and trigger a model reload. The model's native context length is the upper bound (clamped automatically).
api.ws_blacklist_desc: API models that do not support the web search tool are added to this list automatically the first time they fail. From then on, the web search tool is no longer passed to those models, preventing the same failure from repeating. Remove a model from the list to let it try again.
api.img_blacklist_desc: API models that do not support image input are added to this list automatically the first time they fail. From then on, images are no longer sent to those models, preventing the same failure from repeating. Remove a model from the list to let it try again.
api.maps_desc: Used by the location feature. Enter your Google Maps API key.
api.eleven_desc: Set the ElevenLabs API key, refresh your account voices (My Voices) and pick the TTS model. Voices appear in the character editor's TTS dropdown.
